# Privacy Needle Calc

> Free cloud, AI and SaaS cost estimation and comparison tools from Privacy Needle. This website is a planning aid, not a provider price feed or invoice.

Website: https://calc.privacyneedle.com/
Publisher: https://privacyneedle.com/
Last review: 2026-11-10

## Start here
- [Multi-cloud comparison](https://calc.privacyneedle.com/compare/): AWS vs Azure vs Google Cloud vs Oracle using editable workload and provider assumptions.
- [AWS calculator](https://calc.privacyneedle.com/cloud/aws/)
- [Azure calculator](https://calc.privacyneedle.com/cloud/azure/)
- [Google Cloud calculator](https://calc.privacyneedle.com/cloud/google-cloud/)

## Important limitations
Cloud rate values are mixed: some verified example rate references, many illustrative and user-editable planning assumptions. No real-time price API, currency feed, guaranteed regional bill, legal compliance ruling or endorsement by a provider is implied. Performance equivalence between cloud VM reference shapes is not guaranteed. Verify vendor documentation before quoting procurement figures.
